This '''presidential palace''' was located on the [[Bri'ahl|homeworld]] of [[Bri'ahl (species)|the Bri'ahl]]. [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] met [[Vuul]] in the presidential palace, as a [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]].
